title: People’s Mañanera October 26
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Lula Defeats the Right: The People of Brazil Win a Victory  
** “It’s a breath of fresh air for Latin America and the Caribbean,” President
Claudia Sheinbaum declared. She highlighted grassroots organization and the
mobilization of young people to defeat the right-wing.

**Mexico Defends Its Sovereignty: Coordination Without Subordination  
** In response to repeated requests for intervention from the United States,
Sheinbaum refused to allow the presence of foreign forces, as had been
permitted under former president Felipe Calderón. She reaffirmed national
sovereignty and highlighted progress in reducing U.S. tariffs on steel,
aluminium, and automobiles.

**Mexico Grows Through Public Investment and Well-Being  
** Sheinbaum noted that the Mexican economy grew by 3.5% in August 2026,
according to the National Statistics Institute (INEGI). The growth was driven
by public work projects, housing construction, and electronics production.

**There Can Be No Corruption or Privileges in the INE: Sheinbaum  
** The President supported National Electoral Institute (INE) President
Guadalupe Taddei’s decision to resign from her post and demanded audits into
possible abuses and privileges. At the same time, Sheinbaum condemned the
right wing’s misogynistic barbs, stating that investigating Taddei’s
performance in the INE does not justify attacks on her private life.
